description: Apple Silicon metrics from mactop (job "mactop": CPU by core type, GPU, power per component, DRAM bandwidth, temperatures, thermal state, fans) plus node_exporter host metrics (job "node"), and oMLX (job "omlx" and its log in Loki). Configured in hosts/Stroma/monitoring.nix.

panels.title: Total power
panels.description: Whole-machine power where the Mac reports it (DC-in rail on Mac Studio), otherwise the CPU + GPU + ANE + DRAM sum.

panels.title: Thermal state
panels.description: macOS thermal pressure. Serious or Critical means the SoC is throttling.

panels.title: CPU usage by core type
panels.description: M5 chips have P-cores and S-cores instead of E-cores; on them E-cores reads 0.

panels.title: GPU usage
panels.description: Inference load shows up here and in GPU/ANE power.

panels.title: Per-core CPU usage (now)
panels.description: Current usage of each core, labelled by core type.

panels.title: Power by component
panels.description: Stacked; the top of the stack is total power. system is everything outside the SoC components (total minus the others).

panels.title: Total and rest-of-system power
panels.description: total is whole-machine power where reported; system is the part not attributed to CPU, GPU, ANE or DRAM.

panels.title: Thermal state
panels.description: 0 Nominal, 1 Fair, 2 Serious, 3 Critical.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Unified memory: shared by CPU, GPU and model weights.

panels.title: DRAM bandwidth
panels.description: Token generation is usually bound by this. Reads 0 on M5 Ultra with mactop 2.1.6.

panels.title: Filesystem used
panels.description: APFS volumes in one container share free space, so they track together.

panels.title: Exporters up
panels.description: 2 when both node_exporter and mactop are scraped.

panels.title: oMLX
panels.description: 0 when json_exporter can't reach oMLX's /api/status.

panels.title: Requests active / waiting
panels.description: Waiting requests are queued behind the active ones.

panels.title: Model memory
panels.description: Unified memory held by loaded models.

panels.title: Generation speed
panels.description: Mean since oMLX started; the per-request panel below shows recent speed.

panels.title: Prefix cache hits
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache since oMLX started.

gridPos.w: Throughput across all requests, from oMLX's counters.

panels.title: Generation speed per request
panels.description: From oMLX's per-request log lines (Loki): mean tokens/s over 5m per model.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({host=~"$instance", app="omlx"} |~ " tokens in .* tok/s" | regexp `model=(?P<model>[^,]+), \d+ tokens in [\d.]+s \((?P<tps>[\d.]+) tok/s` | unwrap tps [5m]) by (model)

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Streaming chat completions only, from oMLX's log lines (Loki): mean over 5m per model.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({host=~"$instance", app="omlx"} |~ "stream_model_ttft=[0-9]" | regexp `model=(?P<model>[^,]+),.*stream_model_ttft=(?P<ttft>[\d.]+)s` | unwrap ttft [5m]) by (model)

panels.title: oMLX warnings and errors
panels.description: oMLX's server.log, shipped by Alloy on Stroma.
